title: The Third Verdict
author: Emrys Fairweather
blurb: Freya Ashgrove, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
